_note: Second eval set, for the 31-file PDF+DOCX corpus added after questions.json's original 5-file set. Same four types. Includes a deliberate itinerary-draft-conflict probe (two different documents genuinely disagree on Day 1's schedule) and a confirmed real unanswerable trap (chess tournament's 'Total Prize Fund:' field is present but blank in the source PDF).

questions.q: What is the reporting time for the chess tournament?
How much does the non-veg menu cost for adults at Amalfi Chalet?
What accounting method does the KoinX tax report use?
What financial year does the KoinX tax report cover?
What Writ Petition number is referenced in the High Court order?
What does the Hetansh Puzzle Game's Splash Screen do?
questions.expect: shows logo + loading animation, auto-proceeds to sign-in for new users

questions.q: According to the Bullforce whitepaper's table of contents, which section comes right after 'Key Features and Capabilities'?
questions.expect: Use Cases and Specific areas where the cutting edge technology is applied

questions.q: Per the tax report, whose report is it and what currency is used?
Comparing the Camp Ethnosphere form and the Udaipur/Jaisalmer itinerary, which trip happens earlier in the year - the summer camp or the desert trip?
questions.expect: Camp Ethnosphere (Summer 2025, April/May) happens earlier than the Udaipur/Jaisalmer trip (28 Nov - 3 Jan)

questions.q: Do the 'Optimized' and 'DesertTheme' itinerary drafts describe the same Day 1 schedule?
questions.expect: No - Optimized has a detailed 3PM arrival + City Palace + evening Bagore Ki Haveli sequence; DesertTheme's Day 1 is comparatively sparse. The drafts genuinely differ - a good answer should note the discrepancy rather than silently pick one.

questions.q: List all TDCA officials named for emergency contact at the chess tournament, with their roles.
questions.expect: Dr. Deepak Tandel (IA), Mr. Mohit Ladhe (IA), Mr. Rahul Joshi (registration contact, National Instructor & International Arbiter)

questions.q: Summarize what Grade V covered in English, Science, and Math according to the content-coverage document.
questions.expect: English: adjective types/degree of comparison; Science: Ch.3 notes + Ch.2 worksheet; Math: operations on large numbers, subtraction

questions.q: What meals and time slots are listed in the Amalfi Chalet food menu?
questions.expect: Lunch 1:30-2:30 PM, Dinner 8:30-10:30 PM, plus Hi-tea and next-day breakfast mentioned in the package

questions.q: What is the total prize fund for the chess tournament?
questions.expect: not stated - the field is present in the document but left blank

questions.q: What programming language or game engine is the Hetansh Puzzle Game built in?
questions.expect: not in the context - it's a UX/screen spec, not a tech stack doc

questions.q: What was the final ruling or verdict in the High Court Writ Petition?
questions.expect: not in the context unless the order's operative section is retrieved and actually states one - verify against the source, don't assume

questions.q: What is the license plate number of the vehicle used for the Udaipur-Jaisalmer transfers?
